proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on, screen lighting up, and producing a test print or copy.
Photo of the internal meter/page count report.
Close-up photos of toner/drum compartment and waste toner box.
Photos of the rear/underside for rust, corrosion, or water damage.
Photo of the data plate/serial number sticker for age verification.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly readable in the photo, so identity is certain, but no functional proof (power-on, test print, meter count) is shown, so it must be priced at the worst case of a non-working, high-mileage unit of this model pending further proof.
